description:
[Game reference] Item shortnames for the give command. Live items as a copy-paste reference for `give <shortname> <amount>` and `inventory.giveto <player>
<shortname> <amount>`: `shortname` is the exact string those commands expect, plus `display_name`,
`category`, `icon_url` and `stack_size` (the maximum one stack holds). Alphabetical by display name;
cached for 30 minutes. Exact shortnames for the give / inventory.giveto console commands.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the display name or shortname.

name: get_give_item_list
title: Item shortnames for the give command
